pr_title: Add missing None check for hf_quantizer
pr_body: Adds None check for hf_quantizer that otherwise can blow up when `from_pretrained` is called with `quanitization_config=None`.
pr_comments: The docs for this PR live [here](https://moon-ci-docs.huggingface.co/docs/transformers/pr_28804). All of your documentation changes will be reflected on that endpoint. The docs are available until 30 days after the last update.
Added a test. PTAL – I'm not familiar with HF's testing guidelines, so happy to take suggestions.
@jganitkevitch thank you for the quick PR, as this is a bit sensitive we'll merge now!
